items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: my first teacher was a lady by the name of Miss Laura Albert

ctx.x: Well, my first teacher was a lady by the name of Miss Laura Albert. She'd go around visiting houses teaching on Tuesdays and Fridays. And then, from my violin, I played for her, and she put on a concert. So the concert formed at Western Chapel's church. That's up on Liberty, between Adila and Saratoga. And I played, my first number was Waves of the Danube Walls, which is now Al Jolson taking it, and made an anniversary song.
Was the whole program classical music in this concert? Oh yeah.
